entities.name: Berbous
entities.description: The original merfolk Empire of the Otarian Sea on Dominaria, ruled by Emperor Tajaras, later taken over by cephalids.

entities.name: Tajaras
entities.description: Emperor of Berbous, humiliated Laquatus in a duel and was overthrown.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Merfolk courtier and advisor who plotted to overthrow Tajaras.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Cephalid king who joined Laquatus's coup and became Emperor of the Mer Empire.

entities.name: Festival of Rebirth
entities.description: Ritual during which the coup took place.

events.summary: Tajaras calls out Laquatus's schemes and humiliates him in a duel.
events.quote: Tajaras called Laquatus out on his schemes and humiliated him in a duel

events.summary: Laquatus recruits the cephalid king Aboshan to his cause.
events.quote: recruited king Aboshan to his cause

events.summary: During the Festival of Rebirth they disrupt the ritual; the eggs hatch cephalids instead of merfolk and Tajaras's court falls.
events.quote: staged a coup during the Festival of Rebirth

events.summary: Aboshan installs himself as the new Emperor of the Mer Empire.
events.quote: Aboshan instilling himself as the new Emperor of the Mer Empire

relations.quote: It was ruled by Emperor Tajaras
Together, Laquatus and Aboshan staged a coup
